verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents a REST API (notices, faults, projects, deploys), so a downloadable spec is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence shows an OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec, and probes of the standard OpenAPI/Swagger paths all returned 404. The llms.txt files and the MCP server are adjacent features, not an API spec, so they earn no credit here.
